module.Chapter: Chapter 5 · Functions, Files, and Raspberry Pi
module.Title: Organize the Facility Program
module.Teaching: Breaking a large program into small functions makes each responsibility easier to understand, test, and change.
PredictionOptions: Each function has one clear job
module.PredictionExplanation: Small focused functions are easier to test and reuse.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the missing colon, use return for readings, and indent the second return.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the three-function facility structure. Use these exact identifiers: alarm, check_alarms, display_status, f, print, read_sensors, readings. Use these exact values: 21.5, 30, 42.0, "Alarm active: {alarm}", "pressure", "temperature".
module.TransferPrompt: Create read_level(), check_low_level(value), and display_level(status). Use these exact identifiers: f, low_level, print. Use these exact values: 20, 62.5, "Low level: {low_level}".
module.PreviewMessage: The automation program is now divided into maintainable functions.
